tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /bkra shis tshe ring ma mched lnga'i gtor bsngo khyer bde bzhugs so// rang yi dam gyi lha gang rung gi nga rgyal dang ldan pas/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum gyis gtor ma 'dod dgur byin gyis brlabs la rang gi snying nas 'od zer 'phros pas/ bkra shis mthon mthing rgyal mo nas/ dbang phyug tshe ring mched lnga 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ zhes pa spyan drangs/ bris sku sogs rten yod na de dang dbyer med du bsam/ maṃ aṃ aṃ tsaṃ taṃ/ pañtsa ḍā ki sa pa ri wā ra i daṃ ba ling ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ lan gsum maṃ lngas phul/ pañtsaḍa ki ni arghaṃ sogs kyis phyi mchod dang / 'bru gsum gyis nang mchod phul/ dam tshig gi phyag rgya bstan la/ jo mo bkra shis tshe ring ma mched lnga 'khor dang bcas pa/ mkha' 'gro seng ge'i gdong can/ slob dpon padma 'byung gnas/ dbang phyug bzhad pa'i rdo rje la sogs pa rtsa brgyud kyi dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' dang dam las ma 'da' bar rnal 'byor pa bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa'i tshe dang srid srung / rigs brgyud 'phel bdag bstan pa dang sems can la phan bde bskyed pa'i dngos grub bstsal du gsol/ rdor dril lam ting shags sogs brdung zhing / rdzu 'phrul stobs dang sogs kyis bstod pa dang / rdo rje snying kha dang / dril bu tshig brdung bya zhing / sman btsun chen mo 'khor bcas rnams/ /mchod sbyin gtor ma sogs nas/ kun 'grub shog gi bar gyis 'phrin las bcol/ rten med na gtor ma mgron mi dmigs pa nyid kyis chog nyung ngu'i 'khyer bde 'di yang gnyis med a wa dhā ti sangs rgyas phyan tshogs kyis/ zhus dag lags pas sde dge khri thog pa sangs rgyas bstan pa'i thugs dam du lcags ra bsam 'grub rdzong du sug bris so/ /sarba maṅgalaṃ/ shu bhaṃ// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 sangs rgyas phun tshogs/ bkra shis tshe ring ma mched lnga'i gtor bsngo khyer bde/
